title: Research Assistant chat loses context after first turn
description: Research Assistant currently records conversation rows but behaves like one-shot chat. The frontend does not pass the active conversation_id returned by the first /chat/turn response, so the backend creates a new assistant_conversations row for every message. Even when a conversation_id is supplied, backend _chat_messages_for_llm only includes system prompt, Context Pack summary, and current user message; it does not load assistant_conversation_messages history into LLM context. Therefore the second turn forgets prior user requirements, assistant clarifications, and confirmed configuration details.

trigger_condition.backend_gap: LLM messages omit prior assistant_conversation_messages history

reproduce_command: 1) Open /research-assistant/chat. 2) Send: '帮我创建一个 QE 10 loop 实验，先不要执行'. 3) Send: '把刚才那个实验改成只用固定 PIT 股票池'. 4) Observe the second turn is treated as a new request or cannot reliably reference the first turn. Code inspection: frontend/src/app/research-assistant/chat/page.tsx sends chatTurn without conversation_id; backend/services/research_assistant/service.py::_chat_messages_for_llm omits conversation history.
required_verification: Backend unit test: second chat turn with same conversation_id passes bounded prior user/assistant messages into LLM messages.
Frontend test: second send includes conversation_id returned by first chatTurn response.
API test: /conversations/{conversation_id} returns ordered user/assistant messages for both turns.
Regression test: New conversation/reset action clears active conversation_id and does not pollute previous conversation.
closure_requirements: The chat UI preserves active conversation_id across turns until the user explicitly starts a new conversation.
Backend chat_turn loads bounded recent conversation history for the same conversation_id and injects it into LLM context.
History injection excludes raw JSON, database IDs, trace IDs, payloads, and backend logs from the main human conversation prompt.
Token budget handling is explicit: recent turns are bounded and older context is truncated or summarized without silent failure.
BUG-102 registry record and GitHub issue #168 remain synchronized with fix branch, commit, and validation evidence.
